Compare and contrast key facts about 
Vanguard Information Technology ETF (
VGT) and 
Vanguard Mega Cap Growth ETF (
MGK).
VGT and MGK are both exchange-traded funds (ETFs), meaning they are traded on stock exchanges and can be bought and sold throughout the day. VGT is a passively managed fund by Vanguard that tracks the performance of the MSCI US Investable Market Information Technology 25/50 Index. It was launched on Jan 26, 2004.
